caption: The drawing features a rectangular design filled with a pattern composed of floral and leafy motifs. The main colors are dark blue and white, with the dark blue forming the background and outlining the floral and organic shapes, while the white portions create the details of the flowers and leaves. The pattern consists of large, stylized flowers, curved stems, and leaves, with a notable circular floral shape on the right side and elongated petals on the left. The lower edge of the design is bordered with an alternating triangular and floral motif, and the upper edge features a thin checkerboard border. The overall composition is intricate, with interwoven plant forms filling the space. The drawing is surrounded by a plain beige or off-white background, and a handwritten signature is visible in the lower right corner outside the design.
title: Coverlet
